title: docs(qa): 18.0 sweep round 7 — integration-system checklist-accuracy findings and four carried notes
body:
Refs #24579
Clause-②: no

Round 7 of the 18.0 release sweep's wave anchor (#24579), one PR in two parts. Part (a) takes `integration-system`, the last area §3 had not worked, from its run records #24575 (round 1, `5b14b7f3`) and #24615 (round 2, `ba4afcc2`), plus the rows #24556 and #24558 left for this file. Part (b) takes four notes carried from rounds 5 and 6. These are checklist and runner-doc defects only: no product code, test or pin changes.

Every finding was re-derived from `origin/main`'s source before it was edited. Each edited item takes one `revision` bump and one `history` row naming its run record(s). The rows' `ref` is a placeholder in this head; a fill commit replaces exactly those 16 strings with this PR's number.

## Part (a) — `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json`

13 items (cap 20).

| item | fields edited | revision | run record |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` | `fixtures.knownGaps[2]`, `fixtures.knownGaps[4]` (new), `steps[0]`, `steps[8]`, `acceptance[6].clause`, `source[2]` | 4 → 5 | #24575, #24556 |
| `datasource-admin-lifecycle` | `steps[2]`, `steps[3]`, `steps[4]`, `steps[5]`, `steps[8]`, `acceptance[0].clause`, `acceptance[2].clause`, `acceptance[4].clause`, `acceptance[4].verify` | 3 → 4 | #24615 |

| `connector-degraded-recovery` | `fixtures.requires[0]`, `steps[4]`, `steps[6]`, `acceptance[3].verify` | 2 → 3 | #24575 |
| `notify-inbox-delivery` | `fixtures.requires[0]`, `fixtures.knownGaps[2]`, `steps[5]`, `acceptance[3].verify`, `acceptance[4].verify` | 4 → 5 | #24575, #24615 |
| `job-scheduled-run` | `fixtures.requires[1]`, `steps[4]`, `steps[6]`, `acceptance[3].verify` / `.evidence` | 4 → 5 | #24575 |

| `inbound-mailbox-association` | `fixtures.requires[1]`, `fixtures.knownGaps[0]` | 1 → 2 | #24558 |
| `notification-org-and-redeliver-eligibility` | `fixtures.requires[2]`, `steps[2]`, `steps[3]` | 1 → 2 | #24558 |
| `external-datasource-federated-read` | `fixtures.requires[0]`, `steps[4]`, `acceptance[2].oracle` / `.evidence` | 3 → 4 | #24575 |
| `external-schema-drift-gate` | `fixtures.knownGaps[0]`, `steps[0]` | 2 → 3 | #24615 |
| `connector-auth-kind-application` | `steps[1]`, `fixtures.knownGaps[0]`, `source[5]` | 1 → 2 | #24615 |

What each one says now, and the source it was checked against:

- **Postgres recipe (§3's bullet).** The credential matrix's knownGap said no recipe is proven and the QA container has no database. The container has PostgreSQL 16 at `/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin` (re-read in this container), and #24575's recipe scored acceptance[1] and [6] pass. The gap now carries the recipe.
- **`mongodb`, not `mongo`.** `DRIVER_CATALOG` serves `mongodb` (`driver-catalog.ts`), and an authored `mongo` is refused by name since 18 (`datasource.zod.ts`). Fixed in both datasource items.
- **sqlite `filename`.** `SqliteConfigSchema` declares `filename`; `file` is an alias that authoring refuses with a rename hint.
- **`POST /test` order (hypothesis 2).** The item relied on the order: `steps[3]` and `acceptance[2].clause` both stated it. `server.post(root + '/test')` is registered after every `:name` route in `admin-routes.ts`. "test" stays uncaptured only because no POST route takes a bare `:name`. So the ledger text is corrected. The code comment is reported in the acceptance notes below and is not edited.
- **`?schema=` on Postgres (hypothesis 1).** #24619 row (c) is now #24664, which is open. The knownGap's claim that a Postgres fixture would make narrowing live-scoreable is false: `introspectSchema` lists `current_schemas(false)` tables with bare names. It is corrected. `acceptance[1]` states the #7955 contract and stays as written, because the defect makes it false live, not the clause.
- **Browser UI (round 2's §3 additions).**
  - The objectui pin is `12dc7b47c340`, and #24615 ran at `4016370a`. Both were read.
  - `DatasourceResourcePage` rows never open the item, so `steps[1]` names the engine edit route.
  - The save-first guidance is unreachable: `CREATE_MODE_CANVAS_TYPES` is object / report / dataset / doc. `acceptance[0]` now scores the observable half (no name-less call) and records the guidance half as not-run.
  - The quoted refusal belonged to `POST /meta/_migrate-stored`. The item save door answers `metaWriteCapabilityVerdict`'s "Saving a metadata item requires…" with 403 `FORBIDDEN`.
  - A repeated import answers 201 and overwrites: `importObject` makes no existence check. This is recorded as a knownGap that no clause scores.
- **Reload backoff (rounds 3 and 4).** `degradeConnectorInstance` restarts attempts at 1 only on a signature change. A `metadata:reloaded` reconcile retries at once and keeps counting. `steps[6]` now names a restart-free reload: `os dev` restarts on a source save, because its `--restart` defaults to true.
- **Messaging 501 recipe.** `resolveServedCapabilities` skips the always-on slate under `--preset minimal`. The knownGap carries #24615's scratch app-todo recipe.
- **Timeout probe.** `runWithPolicy` retries timeouts. A second probe with a `retryPolicy` is what can show it.
- **`connector-declarative-boot` ref.** It is narrowed clause by clause against the two cases of `showcase-declarative-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`, in the shape round 2 used for `scope-depth-asymmetry`.
- **#24558's rows.**
  - The showcase composes `MailboxServicePlugin`, because `requires` lists `mailbox`. What is missing is the IMAP sync composition, a `mailAssociation` field and an IMAP double.
  - An inactive webhook never gets a delivery: the redeliver guard reads the dispatcher's `active === true` predicate. The item carries the active-then-switch-off recipe. It warns off a pending row, which answers `DELIVERY_NOT_ELIGIBLE` from `assertHttpRedeliverable` for another reason.

## Part (b) — carried notes

| item or section | fields edited | revision | source |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `platform-core.metadata-authoring-roundtrip` | `automated.stale.observedIn` (`#7695` → `#24598`), `.partial`, `.why`, `.ownedBy` | 3 → 4 | Tier 1 run #24598; round 6's note |
| `access-security.activation-write-operator-gate` | `acceptance[3].clause`, `acceptance[4].clause`, `acceptance[4].verify`, `acceptance[5].verify`, `negative[3]`, `source[0]` | 4 → 5 | round 5's note |
| `access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor` | `steps[0]` | 3 → 4 | round 5's note |
| `RUNNER.md` · "Environment facts the runner should not re-derive", the objectui-only `automated.ref` entry | lines 434–439 rewritten (the paragraph runs 434–449) | — | round 6's note |

- **(b)1.** `studio-record-page.spec.ts` has the same blob at `4016370af3c9` and `12dc7b47c340` (read in objectui), and #24598 ran it 0 passed / 1 failed. `ownedBy` names objectstack-ai/objectui#13104. The marker also said `studio-object-designer.spec.ts` was unaffected. #24598 ran its F1 and F4 red, so `partial` and `why` now say so.
- **(b)2.** Each comma-range citation, re-pointed. The cited lines now hold other code.
  - `acceptance[3].clause` `,141-147` → `activation-gate.ts#refuseUngrantedActivationWrite`, plus the header's "What it enforces" `single` bullet (prose).
  - `acceptance[4].verify` `,155-163` → `#refuseUngrantedActivationWrite` (the sentence) and `#FLOW_ACTIVATION_SUBJECT` / `#ACTION_ACTIVATION_SUBJECT` (the remedies).
  - `acceptance[5].verify` `,190` → `#refuseUngrantedActivationWrite` and `#refuseUngrantedActivationAuthoring` (both `isSystem` arms).
  - `negative[3]` `,141-147` → `#readEffectiveTenancyPosture`, plus the header's "Fail-open on an ABSENT posture is deliberate" section (prose).
  - `source[0]` (`#posture`, which resolved only to a local `const posture`, plus five line ranges) → the four symbols above, plus the same header section in prose.
- **(b)3.** `serve.ts#walledPostureRefusal` refuses a walled posture before any config is read, and it reads no `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`. The walled-theme text itself (RUNNER.md's entry and the seven knownGaps) is untouched, waiting for #24667.
- **(b)4: my call is to reword, not to count.** The merged tree is `abb111cb4c`: this branch plus `origin/main` `73d4cc7391`, which includes PR #24697. On it, the rule "an `automated.ref` names an objectui path and no path in this checkout" counts **23** objectui-only items, plus 7 mixed. On the pre-#24697 base `d1173825b7` the same rule counts 27. Round 6 counted 28 before and 24 after by its own rule. The old sentence's "23" therefore matches this tree only by coincidence: it was four short a commit earlier, and a second careful reader counts 24 here. The number moves with every pin edit, and no gate reads it. The entry now states the rule, and keeps every other sentence in it.

**Bounded in-place fixes** (same defect class, mechanical, same file, same gate):
- `activation-write-operator-gate` `acceptance[4].clause`: it said flows recommend the clone path and that the platform_admin POSITION admits. Both remedies name the operator and neither names a clone: `automation-activation-posture-gate.test.ts` asserts `ask your platform operator` with no `clone`, and the action pin asserts no `clone`. The gate reads the PLATFORM_ADMIN posture rung (`ec?.posture === 'PLATFORM_ADMIN'`, #15981). The walled lead of the clause is unchanged.
- `external-schema-browser-ui` `acceptance[3].verify` cited `ExternalDatasourcePanel.tsx,108-123`, and `connector-auth-kind-application` `fixtures.knownGaps[0]` and `source[5]` cited `index.ts,103,142` / `,66,103,142`. These are the (b)2 rot class, re-pointed to a symbol or to prose for objectui.
- `notify-inbox-delivery` `fixtures.requires[0]` spelled recipients `['{record.assignee}']`. The flow declares one CEL value envelope.

## Findings left alone

| finding | refuting reading |
|:--|:--|
| `notify-inbox-delivery`: the `notify` assignee must be a user id (§3; #24575) | Does not hold. `RecipientResolver.resolveOne` sends an email-shaped recipient to `resolveEmail`, which looks up `sys_user` by email under the fan-out system context and returns its id. It keeps the email verbatim only when nothing matches (`recipient-resolver.ts`). A user id works, but it is not required. |
| `external-schema-introspection` `acceptance[1]` and the title's "?schema= honoured" | Product-defect territory (#24664, open). The clause states the #7955 contract. |
| credential matrix: `turso` is absent from `GET /drivers` though `POST` accepts it, and the turso edit form shows only Label | Deliberate curation (`driver-catalog.ts` header: turso needs an optional package, which a dropdown cannot arrange). No item text says otherwise. |
| credential matrix: the metadata door serves the `credentialsRef` handle and the admin door only `hasSecret`, "say whether intended" | A question for the contract, not an inaccuracy. `acceptance[2]` judges the two shapes consistent, and #24575 scored it pass. The new `knownGaps[4]` describes both doors. |
| credential matrix: `schemaMode: "external"` on POST needs an `external` block | No step or clause of this item authors `schemaMode`, so the finding has no target text. |
| credential matrix: the console route is `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/metadata/datasource` | No step of this item names a console route. #24575 (federated-read) and #24615 (browser runner) both reached Setup at `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/datasource`, the spelling the edited steps use. |
| credential matrix: a PATCH writing the literal mask is accepted and overwrites | Held for the maintainer on #24579 §7 (no declared contract). Recorded in `knownGaps[4]` as scored under no clause; no clause changed. |
| `connector-auth-kind-application`: the oauth2 build refusal is a raw zod dump that names no connector | A UX nit. `acceptance[3]` claims a located message only for the inline-`authentication` refusal, which #24615 measured located. |
| #24615: a scratch copy booted from `/tmp` prints "Console dist not found" | A RUNNER environment fact, harmless for API items. RUNNER.md is in scope this round only for the count sentence. |

Excluded files, named only: `studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle` has clause-free pins. The green `summary-rollup.spec.ts` on `records-forms.master-detail-atomic-save` and `grid-conditional-rules.spec.ts` on `records-forms.conditional-rules-grid` over-claim a clause. `records-forms.json`, `studio-authoring.json` (PR #24697) and `cli.json` (PR #24681) are untouched.

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- `packages/services/service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts`: the comment above `POST /test` says it is "Registered before the `:name` routes". It is registered after all of them. There is no runtime effect, because no POST route takes a bare `:name`. Noted for the service-datasource lane.
- The comma-range line-citation spelling survives in other area files. The line-citation limb refuses only `file:NNN` and a bare `:NNN`, so these do not trip it. Hits:
  - in scope for a later round: `access-security.record-view-read-audit`, `access-security.share-link-landing-page`, `ai.console-ai-surface-gating`, `attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced`, three `automation` items, five `identity-auth` items, `platform-core.docs-portal-render`, `search.command-palette-navigation` (15 items);
  - in this round's excluded files: `cli`, `records-forms`, `studio-authoring`.

  Same carrier as (b)2: #24579.

## Gates

On `abb111cb4c` (the branch merged with `origin/main` `73d4cc7391`), `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) derived 13 families. All 13 exited 0, with exit codes captured before any pipe:

- `--ran`: "13 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)". The first pass of `check:doc-formula-expressions` exited 3 because `@objectstack/lint` was unbuilt. It was built under the verify lock and re-run.
- `check:platform-checklist` runs in no per-PR CI, so this reading is its evidence: "OK — 16 areas, 327 items". Symbol anchors went from **886/896** at base to **917/927** resolved, none refused (hypothesis 3); merging #24697 left both totals unchanged. The anchor census moved access-security 96 → 107, integration-system 63 → 83, and platform-core 96 → 96.
- Editing discipline: a span-recording textual editor re-parsed each area file. It asserted that only the declared fields of the declared items changed, each with one `revision` bump and one `history` row, and that every other item and top-level key is deep-equal.
- Changeset: `docs/qa/**` is in no package's `files[]`, so this PR publishes nothing and takes `skip-changeset`.
